subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Things friends do together; describes pictures of friends

show.line: Friends play together! They play ball, skip, build and read stories.

rounds.prompt: Tap the friends reading a book.
Two friends are skipping. How do they look?
What do you like to play with your friends?

rounds.story: Lebo is alone on the bench. Sam asks, do you want to play with us? How does Lebo feel now?

hints: Look at what the children are doing.
Some games need more than one person.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will play seesaw.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I play seesaw all by myself!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A seesaw needs a friend on the other side.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: We need two friends for a seesaw. Up and down!

parent_line: Can describe things friends do together and include others.
